title: Decoding Large-Language Models: A Systematic Overview of Socio-Technical Impacts, Constraints, and Emerging Questions.

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review synthesizing existing studies that use datasets like REALTOXICITYPROMPTS to evaluate the risk of pretrained language models generating toxic text and biased content.
